meaning: Construct two actual distinct-esse subjects without external efficient cause: one lacks the causal-dichotomy premise while retaining the no-self-cause premise; the other allows sufficient efficient causation by essential principles alone while retaining the dichotomy. A third actual subject has a distinct actual external cause and satisfies both source premises. Coherence requires all recorded causes of esse to have actual relata. None is asserted to be metaphysically possible.
